statements.impact_statement: Not exposed: REEVALUATE (touched) — curriculum-controller.ts was edited by the merged canvas-template PR (two new routes appended near line 914+, unrelated to this sink), so the standing not_affected needs re-verification. Re-verified: the sink at line 539 is unchanged in shape — `res.send(result)` where `result` is either EditLeaseService.release (edit-lease-service.ts:84-87, returns `{ released: boolean }` from `count > 0`) or EditLeaseService.releaseAll (edit-lease-service.ts:90-93, returns `{ released: number }` from a Prisma `updateMany` count). Neither payload interpolates any user-supplied string — the shape is a single literal key and a server-computed primitive. Express `res.send` on an object serialises to JSON with Content-Type application/json, which browsers cannot render as HTML. The nosemgrep marker on line 538 is intact. Original disposition re-confirmed with a fresh 90-day window.
